description: Live FAA operational delay status for ONE US airport. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "are there delays at SFO", "is JFK on a ground stop", "why is my flight delayed at ORD". Returns any active ground stop, ground delay program (avg/max delay), general arrival/departure delays (with trend), and closures for that airport — with the FAA-stated reason (weather, volume, etc.). Pass a 3-letter airport code. Empty result = no FAA-reported delays right now.
name: airport_delays
title: Airport Delays
